name: Hail Weather
description: Heavy ice shards are falling from the sky. It’s cold, it’s snowy and one of those ice pieces may fall right in your head.
effect:
- Deal 1 damage to all non Ice-Type Pokémon in the field at the end of each round.
- Ice-types gain +1 Base Special Defense.
- Ice, Water and Normal-Type attacks deal 1 additional damage.
- Attacks with a chance to inflict Frostbite against characters that have sustained Hail Damage roll 1 additional chance dice (while Hail remains active).
